title: I’m Gonna Stick with Ipsy
text:
I got miffed because Ipsy didn’t send me a fancy face cream I’d selected, they ran out and sent me something cheaper (which I loved, but beside the point) so I thought I’d try this.
It’s fine, but you can’t customize and the selections for “full size” products are always tiny items. Never a full size face wash or something useful.
Back to Ipsy, our lover’s quarrel has passed.
label: neutral
